legend: Histology of a secretory carcinoma with the classic ETV6::NTRK3 fusion demonstrates a microcystic/cribriform growth pattern and homogeneous and bubbly eosinophilic secretory material.

Secretory carcinoma of the buccal mucosa. The tumour cells of secretory carcinoma have low-grade vesicular nuclei with finely granular chromatin and distinctive centrally located nucleoli, surrounded by pale-pink granular or vacuolated cytoplasm.

Secretory carcinoma of the parotid gland with ETV6::NTRK3 fusion. The papillary-cystic architectural pattern shows some degree of cyst formation with micropapillary features and hobnailing of the cells.

Papillary-like structures and clusters of epithelial cells with rich, finely granulated cytoplasm and round to oval mildly polymorphic nuclei with discernible nucleoli in a mucinous background (FNAC, Pap).

diagnosis: Secretory carcinoma of the parotid gland with ETV6::RET fusion
legend: Secretory carcinoma has a prominent fibrosclerotic stroma and a solid/microcystic structure. The tumour cells have bland, vesicular, round to oval nuclei and distinctive centrally located nucleoli.
Perineural invasion is seen in the upper right corner.
Microcystic architecture, pale mucinous secretions, and typical nuclear morphology.
SOX10 immunohistochemistry shows diffuse nuclear staining in the tumour cells.
S100 immunohistochemistry shows diffuse cytoplasmic staining in the tumour cells.
Mammaglobin immunohistochemistry shows diffuse cytoplasmic positivity in the tumour cells.

diagnosis: Secretory carcinoma of the parotid gland
legend: Gross section of superficial parotidectomy shows a well-circumscribed haemorrhagic cystic tumour.

diagnosis: Secretory carcinoma of the parotid gland with high-grade transformation (ETV6::NTRK3 fusion was confirmed)
legend: Gross photograph showing an unencapsulated, haemorrhagic, infiltrative mass with a focally cystic cut surface.

diagnosis: The ETV6::NTRK3 chimeric tyrosine kinase of secretory carcinoma
legend: This fusion combines the sterile alpha motif dimerization domain (SAM) of the ETV6 DNA-binding domain with the protein tyrosine kinase domain (PTK) of the transmembrane (TM) NTRK3 tyrosine kinase, generating a ligand-independent constitutively active chimeric tyrosine kinase.

diagnosis: Secretory carcinoma of the parotid gland
legend: The tumour exhibits a lobulated growth pattern with fibrous septa, and it is composed of microcystic/solid and tubular structures with prominent luminal secretion.
